minutes.headline: ZBA granted a special permit to build a single-family house on an undersized lot at 410 Hollis Road.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a special permit application from CD Realty Trust to build a new house on a non-conforming lot at 410 Hollis Road. Board members questioned why the owner demolished the old house without coming to the ZBA first, and two neighbors spoke. A motion to grant the permit was made and seconded, the chair announced it granted, and the board adjourned.
